title: Validity inside the DSC validity
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 4. Step 3 — Build the CWT claim set; HCERT Specification, 3.2.5 Expiration Time; HCERT Specification, 3.2.6 Issued At. QR Code Generation, 4. Step 3 — Build the CWT claim set: “MUST NOT predate the DSC validity period ... MUST NOT exceed the DSC validity period”.

statements.label: Validity inside the DSC validity
statements.requirement: Before signing, the issuer SHALL check that iat is not before the DSC notBefore and exp is not after the DSC notAfter, and SHALL refuse to sign otherwise.
